channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Kherson braces for return of war as localised Russia-Ukraine truce ends
item.description: Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

item.title: How will the Iran war shape the outcome of the US midterm vote?
item.description: The conflict has become a central issue ahead of Tuesday's polls.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill eight including child, hospitals say
item.description: Five officers from the Hamas-run police have been killed in Khan Younis and three people, including a child, killed in Gaza City, officials say.
